eligibility_rules: The parents of the girl should be permanent residents of Punjab. Girls should be born after 1.1.

Abundant Girls were found after 1.1.2011 and are residing in orphanages and Children's Homes in the Punjab State. This benefit will be given to those families whose annual income is less than Rs.30,000/- and the proof of income will be the blue card issued by the Food and Supply Department, Punjab. The number of girls born before will not matter to get benefits under the scheme. If the girl child drops from school due to any reason then no benefit will be given to the beneficiaries or the families after that date.
